rows.whatYouDo_da: Vi modtager kølevarer (mozzarella, skinke, grønt) to gange om ugen fra grossist.
rows.whatYouDo_en: We receive chilled goods (mozzarella, ham, vegetables) twice a week from a wholesaler.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Varerne kan være for varme eller emballagen beskadiget ved levering.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Goods may arrive too warm or with damaged packaging.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Modtagekontrol: temperatur stikprøves med termometer, emballage og holdbarhed tjekkes.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Receiving check: spot-check temperature with a thermometer, inspect packaging and dates.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Varen afvises og leverandøren kontaktes; afvigelsen registreres.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Reject the goods and contact the supplier; record the deviation.

hazards.description_da: Sygdomsfremkaldende bakterier i varer leveret over 5 °C.
hazards.description_en: Pathogenic bacteria in goods delivered above 5 °C.
hazards.controlMeasure_da: Modtagekontrol med termometer ved hver levering.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Receiving temperature check at every delivery.
hazards.justification_da: Brudt kølekæde ved levering er en kendt risiko for friske mejeri- og kødvarer.
hazards.justification_en: A broken cold chain at delivery is a known risk for fresh dairy and meat.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Frostvarer (skaldyr, grøntsager) modtages og lægges straks på frost.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Frozen goods (seafood, vegetables) are received and moved straight to the freezer.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Optøede varer ved levering; genfrysning giver bakterievækst.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Goods thawed on arrival; refreezing enables bacterial growth.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Tjek at varerne er hårdfrosne ved modtagelse; direkte på frost.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Check goods are solidly frozen at receipt; straight to the freezer.

hazards.description_en: Bacterial growth in partially thawed frozen goods.
hazards.justification_da: Optøning under transport kan ikke ses efter genindfrysning.
hazards.justification_en: Thawing in transit is invisible after refreezing.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Mel, tomat på dåse og tørvarer modtages og lagres på tørlager.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Flour, canned tomatoes and dry goods are received and stored in the dry store.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Emballage og mærkning tjekkes ved modtagelse.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Packaging and labelling are checked at receipt.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Varen afvises eller mærkes korrekt før brug.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Reject the goods or re-label correctly before use.

hazards.description_en: Undeclared allergens in dry goods (gluten, nuts).
hazards.controlMeasure_da: Mærkning kontrolleres mod følgeseddel ved modtagelse.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Labelling is checked against the delivery note at receipt.
hazards.justification_da: Pizzadej og pasta indeholder gluten; korrekt information til gæster kræver korrekt mærkning.
hazards.justification_en: Pizza dough and pasta contain gluten; correct guest information requires correct labelling.
